topic: Dynamic VA feature rollout and configuration
summary_markdown: A task was completed to enable toggling of the "company.enableDynamicVA" setting on the platform. The immediate need was to deploy this new setting urgently, but updating the User Interface (UI) with all new settings is not time-sensitive and should be handled systematically.
decisions: The ability to toggle 'company.enableDynamicVA' has been implemented for standard release.
